objective_contribution: Convert the H44 selection bottleneck into a reusable completion-time effect-evidence mechanism and test it on GLM-5.3-flash 8K within non-increasing cumulative model input plus output tokens.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does completion-time effect-evidence closure convert the H44 selection ceiling into a deployable quality gain within the fixed token gate?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Tokenizer-only preflight, exact freeze, live run, scoring, and reviewed decision remain.

measurement_mapping.native: Score all 24 scheduled zero-filled pairs for Span-F1 and File-F1.
measurement_mapping.retention: Audit terminal effect-state presentation and deterministic final selection closure.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Require receipt binding, positive old-side effect-range overlap, unchanged common prefix/policy, exact ancestry, no reruns, and full missingness.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every prefix and branch model input plus output token; treatment must not exceed control.
measurement_mapping.transfer: This exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K development round cannot prove untouched, larger-window, other-model, domain, or repair-correctness transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter before larger windows
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight-task cohort with three repetitions per arm; reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: One frozen run. No within-round tuning or reruns. Pass advances to untouched confirmation; fail returns to competing hypotheses.

retained_counterevidence: Round 25 passed quality but added 234,147 known model tokens.
Round 26 gained only 0.011412 Span-F1, lost 0.042328 File-F1, and added 47,182 known tokens.
H44 oracle selection gained 0.044032 Span-F1 and 0.065972 File-F1 over equal-token placebo, but only 26 of 48 pairs executed.
GLM followed oracle-ranked IDs only about 57% of the time, motivating deterministic closure.
No exposed development result establishes untouched confirmation or full clearance.
successor_rule: Run one frozen Round 28 comparison. A complete development pass advances to untouched confirmation. Any failed criterion closes H45 and returns to an explicitly registered successor hypothesis.
